metaTitle: Word for lawyers on Mac: review, redlines, clauses
description: Microsoft Word for lawyers on Mac: Track Changes, comments and Compare, plus how Lazur points at the clause you need and explains a redline.
targetKeyword: microsoft word for lawyers on mac
intro: Word for lawyers on a Mac comes down to three tools: Track Changes, comments and Compare. Lazur sits on top: hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask where a clause is, or what a redline changed, and it answers on your screen.
tldr: Turn on Track Changes in Review > Track Changes before you edit.
Use Review > Compare to see what changed between two versions.
Ask Lazur “where's the indemnity clause?” and it points at it.

faq.question: Does Lazur edit the document?
faq.answer: No. It points, explains and drafts text at your cursor. You make every change.

faq.question: Should I use it with client documents?
faq.answer: Check your firm's rules on AI tools first. Lazur sees your screen only while you hold the shortcut and does not store it.
